basis: Intestinal hamartomas and lipomas define BRRS; vascular malformations/angiomatosis 80-99%; scoliosis 30-79%. Macrocephaly alone does not establish neurologic damage.
Congenital corneal flattening, opacity and reduced visual acuity; confined to the eye.
Neonatal blood/marrow malignancy; hepatic leukemic infiltration occurs in most (~70%). Skin infiltration estimates straddle 30%, so omitted.
Isolated cerebellar hypoplasia causes motor, cognitive and language impairment; hypotonia reflects neurologic dysfunction.
Congenital retinal synaptic dysfunction; developmental language impairment 4/6 and ataxia 2/6; associated glucose dysregulation/hyperglycemia 3/4.
Defining elliptocytosis, hearing loss and nephrocalcinosis; cleft palate 2/2 supports oral involvement. Skeletal/cardiac anomalies reported in tiny samples omitted under cap.
Respiratory ciliary dysfunction causes chronic airway disease; chronic middle-ear disease/hearing loss affects most (>50%). Recurrent infections are secondary.
Cutaneous mucinosis affects the skin; a lymphoma subtype does not establish lymphoma or immune disease across this umbrella.
Muscular dystrophy, early contractures and cardiac conduction disease form the defining triad. Lipid abnormalities do not establish additional direct organ damage.
Immune-mediated neutrophilic dermal inflammation; supplied HPO lists small-vessel vasculitis and myositis at 30-79% each. Arthralgia and neutrophilia alone do not qualify.
Oocyte/embryo maturation failure causes female infertility; purely reproductive without demonstrated endocrine dysfunction.
Profound developmental impairment and cataracts each occur in 5/5; hearing impairment in 2/5 (40%). Precocious puberty 1/5 is below threshold.
Umbrella predominantly covering structural chest-wall, rib and shoulder-girdle malformations. Respiratory ancestry alone does not establish intrinsic airway or lung damage.
Neurodevelopmental impairment and external/inner-ear abnormalities define the syndrome; visual impairment 3/5 (60%) and cleft palate 1/2 (50%) support involvement.
Hypoderma larvae infest and migrate through skin/subcutis. Ocular infestation is a subtype rather than involvement established in most cases.
Autoimmune blistering skin disease in children. Associated coeliac enteropathy is a separately diagnosed disease.
Childhood immune-mediated inflammatory skeletal myopathy; no additional directly damaged organ is established at >=30%.
Neoplasm originates in the lung. Neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine gland disease or common hormonal dysfunction.
Usher syndrome combines retinal rod-cone degeneration with congenital sensorineural hearing loss.
Corticospinal tract degeneration causes pure spastic paraplegia; muscle weakness and atrophy are secondary to neurologic disease, not primary muscle damage.
Pure personality disorder without direct damage to any of the thirteen organ axes.
Warburg micro syndrome is defined by severe neurodevelopmental abnormalities, cataracts/microphthalmia and hypogonadotropic hypogonadism.
Arteriovenous malformation occupies the maxillary bone and its vasculature. Dental mobility, epistaxis and ear/eye pain do not establish additional organ damage.
Inherited magnesium homeostasis disorder. Cramps, tetany, tremor and weakness are electrolyte effects without established structural muscle or nervous-system damage.
Skeletal dysplasia with bone fragility and low bone density. Hearing loss and dentinogenesis imperfecta vary by subtype and age; >=30% across this umbrella is uncertain.
